WITH Consumption2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           y.CustomerID,
           SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
MinConsumption AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinTotal
    FROM Consumption2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
LowestConsumers AS (
    SELECT t.Segment,
           SUM(t.TotalConsumption) AS TotalConsumption,
           COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers
    FROM Consumption2013 AS t
    JOIN MinConsumption AS m
      ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.TotalConsumption = m.MinTotal
    GROUP BY t.Segment
),
SegmentAverages AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           TotalConsumption / NumCustomers AS AvgConsumption
    FROM LowestConsumers
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT AvgConsumption FROM SegmentAverages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;
